newsitem.title: GERMANY: Herlitz Intl sees 1996 pretax halved.
newsitem.headline: Herlitz Intl sees 1996 pretax halved.

text.p: German office products supplier Herlitz International Trading AG said on Friday it expected 1996 pretax profit to slump 50 percent to 16 million marks as a result of declining paper prices.
Sales are expected to slip 30 percent to 500 million marks, the company said.
Herlitz said it expected its paper products subsidiaries, including HIT Beteiligungsgesellschaft mbH, to contribute only 13.4 million marks to operating profit, 60 percent less than in 1995.
"That is the result of lower prices coming down on margins already under pressure," Herlitz said.
Paper product sales should reach 442 million marks this year, the company said.
